title: security(expr): attribute traversal is data-only (code objects refused by real type)

carrier_note: patch-133-data-only-traversal.patch is absent from gist 501029c5, #133 comment 6235415328 and #156. The fix was implemented from the issue specification by the landing seat.

cases.msg: expression field name '__class__' is not allowed in an expression path: names starting with '_' are reserved for Python internals (for example __class__ / __globals__ / __init__), so the attribute form reaches process state and bypasses the $ENV allowlist, which is an opt-in exposure list and not a sandbox. Only this prefix is gated: public attributes of node-returned objects stay readable by desi
string indices must be integers, not 'NoneType'
